topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing and outlines the key learning outcomes for the lecture.

topics.label: Discovery of cellular oncogenes and experimental transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of transforming tumor viruses led to the identification of cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays to assess cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification and mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional categories of cancer-associated genes and examine how mutations in oncogenes and tumor suppressors alter cell cycle checkpoints and protein function.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in DNA repair pathways and mitotic chromosome segregation produce sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression, hereditary predisposition, and tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how stepwise mutation accumulation and inherited gene defects drive tumor development and subsequent tumor evolution.

topics.label: Closing remarks and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing framing, concluding the lecture with recommended reading and logistics for upcoming sessions.
